scope: Visual-only assessment of all 24 actual cycle 9 renders against the supplied approved spawn reference pixels and current visual rubric. No scene/source changes or technical/runtime certification.

evidence.inspection_method: Opened each actual PNG with view_image at original detail; no contact-sheet-only or file-existence inference.
evidence.independence_note: The initially requested RUBRIC.md and CAMERAS.md contained superseded cycle 7 scores/claims. Those incidental historical claims were reported to the parent and disregarded. The parent replaced them with neutral definitions; the neutral current rubric was reread before scoring. No earlier critic, TASK_STATE, implementation or earlier render was opened.

categories.name: Layout and route readability
evidence: ENTRY, REVERSE and PINCH retain legible central movement space and clear perimeter functions.
Four corner cutaways show a consistent visible room arrangement with restrained clustering.
deductions: Only apparent route readability is scored; exact clearance and preservation of historical boundaries require separate objective evidence.

categories.name: Grounded stylized art and silhouettes
evidence: Framed chamber, doorway leaves, scissor cart, guarded console controls and tubular recovery berth are specific constructed forms.
Blue painted equipment, off-white clinical surfaces, purple-grey walls and charcoal lower zones follow the supplied spawn palette and controlled simplification.
deductions: Sink and cart cushions remain more primitive than the best authored forms.
Some repeated square fasteners and slab-like cushions reduce silhouette sophistication.

categories.name: OCRU hero function and focal clarity
evidence: The single red practical bed chamber dominates gameplay and frontal views.
Side ports, lift, pillow, rails, controls and adjacent restart/cartridge functions communicate reanimation workflow.
The closed bag remains a subordinate hidden narrative element.
deductions: Carriage cushions and the rear chamber surfaces are smooth and spare.
The restart system is clear but visually simple in its repeated display and button housings.

categories.name: Materials and anti-plastic quality
evidence: Painted blue housings, darker rubber-like grips, broad matte bedding/gloves, pale paper, metal rails and dark glass are visibly differentiated.
No uniform glossy-plastic response or photographic grunge dominates.
Surface frequency is restrained and reference-compatible.
deductions: Sink metal reads as largely diffuse grey plate rather than distinctly stainless construction.
Some cushions and countertops have limited tactile variation.
Cabinet and decon shadow compress secondary material identities.

categories.name: Dark lighting and atmosphere
evidence: Red bed practical and warm supply practical establish localized focal zones.
Neutral/cool secondary response preserves the floor route and frame while the ceiling remains dark.
The room feels subdued and oppressive without losing the mandatory camera silhouettes.
deductions: Decon hardware, reserve interior and cabinet stock sit close to the lower readability limit.
The MEDICAL / OCRU entry heading is dim.

categories.name: Purposeful dressing and neglected workplace story
evidence: Clinical instruments, bandages, gloves, labelled stock and used-PPE disposal are purposeful work props.
The shift log's repeated no-pulse/repeat/release-denied sequence and continuity-productivity poster produce specific institutional horror.
A closed concealed bag with a tiny note adds a quieter cue.
Localized patching, poster damage, floor marks and dark red angular stains keep neglect restrained.
deductions: The strongest neglect is on the poster/paper rather than equipment contact surfaces.
Some wall repair patches and floor stains read as very flat polygons.

technical.reason: Geometry, measured clearance, exact room-boundary preservation, support contact, dependencies, reproducibility, cold start and runtime were not inspected or inferred.

decision.full_section_completion: NOT ESTABLISHED BY THIS VISUAL REVIEW
decision.reason: All six visual categories exceed their 85% minima, all 24 views pass and no dominant visual veto appears. The visual subtotal is 81.1/90. Full 90/100 acceptance still depends on a separately evidenced technical score of at least 8.9/10 plus all protocol gates, including stable final cycles and cold start.

hard_veto_audit.unsupported_prop_claim: No obvious floating prop dominates the inspected pixels; support contact is not certified.

reference_comparison.match: The medical room carries the spawn references' institutional off-white/blue/charcoal palette, controlled constructed edges, useful signage, localized practical light and clustered human work props. Red clinical machinery and deeper shadows provide the requested bleaker identity.
reference_comparison.difference: The spawn plates are brighter and warmer in their main work areas. Cycle 9 appropriately lowers overall exposure but gives less material information inside decon and cabinet shadows. The medical sink and pad surfaces are simpler than the stronger spawn door/locker/bench examples.
reference_comparison.not_claimed: No exact reference geometry, protected asset copying, original layout preservation, or runtime equivalence is inferred.

camera_reviews.evidence: The red chamber reads immediately at left; the recovery berth and rear service stations leave a broad, legible central floor route. The unlit ceiling reads as a deliberate secondary mass.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Rear console and cabinet details are subdued, but their silhouettes remain identifiable.

camera_reviews.evidence: The blue/off-white entry leaves and dark opening form a clear destination. Warm supplies at left and red chamber at right retain the two practical light zones.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The MEDICAL / OCRU heading is low contrast; this does not obscure the doorway itself.

camera_reviews.evidence: The floor rectangle, console/rack edge, decon threshold and recovery edge are visually separable. The camera shows the route rather than hiding it behind the hero.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Decon internals and cabinet contents are close to the lower readability limit.

camera_reviews.evidence: Layered cushion, rails, clamps, telescoping side tube and stepped lift assembly read as a manufactured clinical carriage. The dark closed bag remains beneath the carriage.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Cushion tops are smooth and shallow; the lift's repeated stepped blocks are simpler than the strongest reference props.

camera_reviews.evidence: Medical bottles, gloves, bandages, tray, scissors and logged repeat/no-pulse/release-denied sequence form a purposeful clinical cluster. Matte paper and gloves separate from metal tools.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The counter wear is a sparse set of straight lines rather than a strongly convincing use pattern.

camera_reviews.evidence: Whole-room cutaway shows a clear central negative-space zone with the chamber, recovery bed, workbench and rear services grouped around it. Red and warm pools remain localized.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: This cutaway cannot establish the visibility or physical support of hidden wall/ceiling geometry.

camera_reviews.evidence: The opposite cutaway reveals the chamber front and rear service grouping without changing the readable perimeter arrangement.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Retained dark ceiling beams cross the diagnostic view; gameplay views cover the regions they obscure.

camera_reviews.evidence: Reverse cutaway keeps the entry, workbench, recovery berth and chamber as distinct functional masses, with an obvious central route.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Backs of equipment are quiet and dark, appropriate here but not proof of hidden construction quality.

camera_reviews.evidence: The final whole-footprint cutaway confirms the same visible hierarchy from the fourth direction; no visual clutter wall competes with the red chamber.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The rear alcove reads as a simple dark volume at this scale.

camera_reviews.evidence: Entry framing, opposed blue leaves, cream upper panels and dark passage form a believable institutional threshold. Light pools frame the open floor.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The entry heading is dim and the immediate external space is black.

camera_reviews.evidence: The large chamber has a specific framed silhouette, red clinical interior, side interface housings and a substantial platform. Its dominance is intentional.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The cart and reserve bank at the edges are dark; the frame's repeated square fasteners are somewhat mechanical in rhythm.

camera_reviews.evidence: Restart console, cartridge rack and decon opening read as three distinct service functions. Surface conduit provides restrained construction logic.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The upper wall and decon remain low contrast; further dimming would damage this view.

camera_reviews.evidence: Recovery bedding, wash fixture and warm supply bench form a readable secondary composition. Institutional blue/purple/off-white blocking matches the supplied spawn language.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Physical neglect is lighter than the distressed poster; cabinet glass and contents are dark.

camera_reviews.evidence: The red bed is the unequivocal focal point, with carriage, pillow, lift, side ports and rear panels visible. The chamber reads as clinical industrial equipment rather than decorative sci-fi.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Large bed surfaces and rear panels are smooth; wear is modest.

camera_reviews.evidence: Two physically framed status screens, guarded controls, drawer stack and service cabinet create an understandable practical console. Labels serve function.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Repeated rectangular screen/drawer masses are simple, and the lower cabinet is nearly black.

camera_reviews.evidence: Bottle silhouettes, cap colors, rack shelves and row indexing communicate a medical cartridge bank; repetition is functionally justified.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Dark rack back and decon suppress material differences.

camera_reviews.evidence: Open blue enclosure and two framed handled modules are distinguishable from the neighboring console.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The open door and interior approach black, reducing separation of the enclosure and modules.

camera_reviews.evidence: Door frame, looped hose, wall service box, yellow used-PPE bin and grated floor establish a believable decontamination niche.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Upper hardware and hose connections are hard to inspect in the heavy shadow; the main function is still readable.

camera_reviews.evidence: Tubular berth frame, hanging sheet, pillow and folded blue cover provide readable fabric versus metal construction and human scale.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Blanket grooves and cushion forms remain simple; the wall repair patches are visually flat.

camera_reviews.evidence: Three pads, scissor lift, wheels and yellow handling accents give the transfer cart a specific manufactured silhouette.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: Uniform pad slabs and dark wheel region are the least developed parts of this asset.

camera_reviews.evidence: A warm functional workbench includes sharps disposal, clinical consumables, paperwork and boxed stock, with quiet wall space around it.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The pale counter is very clean outside the sparse scratches, and shelf boxes are strongly repeated.

camera_reviews.evidence: Folded basin rim, tap, dark bowl and molded soap dispenser identify a handwash station without relying on text.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The basin and tap remain box/tube-like; a convincing drain/bowl construction is weak from these pixels.

camera_reviews.evidence: Blue painted framing, paired glazed doors, handles and internal shelf/box silhouettes identify the clinical supplies cabinet.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: The glass interior is near black; material separation and stock identity are weak, but the cabinet silhouette passes.

camera_reviews.evidence: The bag is visibly closed along a continuous zipper, with broad soft folds and a tiny muted yellow note. The special inspection fill is explicitly identified in the camera metadata.
camera_reviews.nonblocking_limitation: This filled inspection camera cannot establish the bag's normal gameplay illumination. In HERO_OCRU it is subordinate and concealed beneath the bed.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: The basin is a shallow grey rectangular box with a tube-like tap; the dark bowl lacks a strong drain/bowl construction cue.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.suggested_correction: Refine the bowl depth, drain cue and folded-metal transitions while retaining the current placement and footprint.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.numerical_check: Not applicable to this visual review; any edit must retain the independent boundary/support checks.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: Several pads read as uniform smooth slabs; their material and use character is weaker than the surrounding manufactured hardware.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.suggested_correction: Add a few broad compression/fold and seam cues with localized wear; preserve angular simplification and low texture frequency.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: Dark hose connections, cabinet stock and reserve interior lose separation despite retaining their overall silhouettes.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.suggested_correction: Protect the present gameplay readability; if refining, adjust a restrained existing accent/bounce or local broad value rather than raising whole-room exposure.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.numerical_check: Lighting source count/power and render consistency were not technically verified.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: Poster/log storytelling is stronger than physical equipment wear; wall patches and dark red floor marks are very flat, and counter scratches are a small set of straight lines.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.suggested_correction: Refine a few high-contact repair/wear shapes and stain boundaries with authored low-frequency value changes. Retain quiet wall space and avoid blanket grunge or extra filler props.

limits: Only cycle 9 was inspected, so this report does not establish final-two-cycle material stability.
Cutaways deliberately hide wall/ceiling planes and are supporting composition evidence.
HIDDEN_BAG uses a declared temporary 2 W inspection fill and is not normal gameplay lighting evidence.
Image framing and apparent scale do not prove geometry, boundaries, physical support, clearance, or runtime behavior.
